name: Landscape Tools
description: RQL module for Unreal's Landscape and Water systems: query landscapes (sections, paint layers), water bodies and water zones.
_comment: Install-catalog metadata (one unreal-mcp-cli ExtensionDescriptor). 'version' is the .uplugin VersionName; change both with `python scripts/extension_release.py bump --plugin <Plugin> --version <x.y.z>`. 'tools' is empty: the extension adds an RQL module (docs/rql.md), not MCP tools. 'minCoreVersion' is the lowest supported Unreal-MCP core; 'enginePlugins' are the engine plugins the installer enables.
